Subject: Implementation kickoff — availability & agenda request

Hi Marcus + team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Aurelia is excited to kick off the implementation. We'd like to schedule the formal kickoff to align on scope, roles, and the first two sprint deliverables. High-level asks:

- Confirm a 60–75 minute slot next week for a cross-functional kickoff.
- Share a brief agenda and the Redwood hosts for each section (technical, security, success).
- Include any onboarding artifacts we should review ahead of the call.

Our preferred windows (PT): Tue 9/8 10:00–12:00, Wed 9/9 13:00–15:00, Thu 9/10 09:30–11:30. If none work, propose two alternatives.

I've attached our internal MVP scope for context (MVP_scope.xlsx) — apologies if there is overlap with the scope doc you shared. Procurement will likely join for commercial headcount & timelines.

Ben Cho
Onboarding Lead, Aurelia Systems
bcho@aureliasys.com

Hi Ben — great to hear and thanks for the windows. 

We can do Tue 9/8 10:30–11:45 PT. Proposed agenda below (60–75 min):

1) Welcome & goals (Marcus Lin, 5 min)
2) Customer context & success criteria (Ben, 10 min)
3) Architecture & data flows (Karthik Iyer, 20 min)
4) Security/compliance touchpoints (Monica Patel, 10 min)
5) Implementation timeline & immediate next steps (Marcus, 10 min)
6) Q&A & action items (all, 10–20 min)

Meeting link (tentative): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=onboard123
Calendar invite attached — I put Marcus, Monica, and Karthik as Redwood hosts. Please confirm attendee list and whether procurement should be on the main call or a separate procurement-only session.

Prep docs attached: Aurelia_Kickoff_Agenda_v1.pdf (short deck), shared drive with runbooks: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d5e6f.

If that time works, I'll send the invite and a short prework checklist for the customer.

Thanks,

Adding a couple of operational notes so the agenda maps to roles: 

- I'll cover compliance artifacts and the evidence checklist (SOC 2 scope, logging retention TTLs). Please ask Ben for the list of systems that will integrate (SFTP/API endpoints).
- Karthik — can you be prepared to speak to model pinning/versioning and expected latency SLOs? 20 minutes should be fine if we keep diagrams focused.
- Marcus — suggest we capture action items live and assign owner+ETA in the invite description. I can own follow-up for security attachments.

Also: recommend we add a 10-minute cadence discussion to agree on weekly check-ins (bi-weekly for execs). I'll bring a short template.
